LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Enlist_Letter_Label: Your colony now stands with the Dark Brotherhood. Open the guild ledger at any settlement hosting them to draw pay, take work and see your standing.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Enlist_Button_Desc: Perform the Black Sacrament and wait. Someone will come.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Enlist_Requrements_: The Dark Brotherhood does not trust you yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Enlisted_To_Hostile: You cannot join the Dark Brotherhood while your colony is at odds with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Missions_Desc: See what work the guild has posted.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Menu_Missions_Desc: Open contracts posted by the Dark Brotherhood. Accepting one costs nothing; payment comes when it is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Salary_Desc: Collect your share from the guild's steward.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Provisions_Desc: Take what the guild sets aside for its members on the road.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in the guild's keeping and collect them from any hall.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave the Dark Brotherhood? Your standing will suffer for it.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Resign_Letter_Label: Your colony has left the Dark Brotherhood. Its doors are closed to you for now.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Resign_Button_Desc: Give up your membership and every rank that goes with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Kick_Out_Label_Titl: Relations have fallen too far. The Dark Brotherhood has struck your colony from its books.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Work_0_Desc: A quiet job, far from anyone who might remember you.
LanguageData.ESCP_DarkBrotherhood_Work_1_Desc: Practice killing under those who are very good at it.
